locations.note: The game begins at an archaeologist's camp on Easter Island, where a moai hides the first time portal.
A portal leads into an Ancient Egyptian temple complex with tomb puzzles.
A Maya jungle city with ball-court and pyramid puzzles is one of the lost civilizations visited.
The Anasazi cliff dwellings of the American Southwest form another time-portal world.
After collecting the three civilization gene pods, the player explores the fifth area, the lost city of Atlantis, placed where Plato put it: beyond the Pillars of Heracles, out in the Atlantic.
